name: context-canary
description: Development test entry for the Context Canary marketplace; installs use plugins/context-canary.

word.title: Canary word
word.description: Start each final reply with this word or emoji. Run /canary setup after changing it.

autoCompact.title: Automatic compaction
autoCompact.description: Compact after a missing sentinel; disable for notifications only.

cooldownMinutes.title: Recovery window (minutes)
cooldownMinutes.description: A second death within this window locks automatic recovery until /clear. Zero disables the window.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: English or Spanish. This API has no UI locale accessor.

size.title: Canary size
size.description: tiny (3 terminal rows), small (4), normal (6) or large (8).

showDetails.title: Show details beside the cage
showDetails.description: Show streak and recovery notes next to the canary. Off: only the canary; /canary status has the details.
